_provenance: Hand-encoded on 2026-09-19 from Riot's own 16.18 game files
(raw.communitydragon.org/16.18/game/data/characters/drmundo/drmundo.bin.json),
cross-checked against wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Dr._Mundo (V26.18 era):
every number below agrees between the two. The bin's DataValues and
cooldownTime carry a rank-0 entry ahead of ranks 1-5 (1-3 for R).
Innate regeneration: the bin's MaxHealthRegen calculation is 0.4% at level
1, +0.05 a level through 6, +0.1 from 7, +0.15 from 13, +0.2 from 16
(ByCharLevelBreakpoints), i.e. 0.4-2.3% of maximum health every 5 seconds,
the wiki's range. Heart Zapper: 8% current health, up to 3 s, stores
80-95% (by level, the bin's GrayHealthStorageInitial interpolation) of the
post-mitigation damage taken in the first 0.75 s and 25% after as grey
health, healed back at 100% if the detonation hits a champion (325
radius) and 50% if not; recast lockout 0.5 s. Maximum Dosage: base health
+15/20/25% of MISSING health at once and 20/40/60% of MAXIMUM health
healed over 10 s (1/2/3% every 0.5 s, scaling with his maximum health as
it changes); at rank 3 both are raised by 5 percentage points for each
enemy champion within 1200 units when it is cast (the wiki: 50% and 85%
against five). Blunt Force Trauma's passive AD (2/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2% of
maximum health) only feeds Maw of Malmortius's shield here.
Skill order Q > E > W: the most played on 16.18 (u.gg, metasrc, Blitz,
2026-09-19). Mundo's character file carries no RecSpellRankUpInfo. At
level 16 that is Q5 E5 W3 R3.
This kit only takes damage: data/builds/drmundo.json is the first tank,
scored on how long he survives the modeled carries' best builds (the
Survival tier), not on damage dealt. Base stats are NOT duplicated here:
the stat layer reads data/builds/champions/<patch>/drmundo/.
name: Dr. Mundo
notes: Survival only: Mundo takes damage and never deals it. Everything that heals or protects him without needing a hit of his own counts; lifesteal, omnivamp and on-hit healing don't.
Goes Where He Pleases regenerates 0.4-2.3% of his maximum health every 5 s (1.9% at 16), continuously, on top of his base regeneration.

Heart Zapper goes out when the fight starts and again on cooldown. It costs 8% of his current health, stores 93% (at 16) of the damage he takes in its first 0.75 s and 25% after that, and heals it back when it detonates at 3 s: all of it if the attacker stands within its 325 radius (Kassadin), half if not (Kayle at 625 range). He detonates early if that heal would keep a hit from killing him.

Maximum Dosage is cast at the health threshold that keeps him alive longest against each attacker, found by trying every 10% step (and at the last moment, when a hit would otherwise kill him). With one enemy champion near, rank 3 gives 30% of missing health as base health and heals 65% of maximum health over 10 s.

Infected Bonesaw refunds its whole health cost when it hits a champion, so casting it changes nothing about how long he lasts; Blunt Force Trauma only costs health. Neither is cast. The crowd-control immunity and its canister wait for crowd control, which nothing here applies.

attack.note: never: a Survival fight scores only the damage Mundo takes, so he never attacks and on-hit effects, lifesteal and omnivamp never fire. windup = 30% + Riot's attack cast offset -0.139687, kept for the record

passive.name: Goes Where He Pleases
passive.note: percent of MAXIMUM health every 5 s, level 1 first: the bin's MaxHealthRegen breakpoints. The immobilize immunity (4% current health, a canister that heals 4% maximum health) needs crowd control, which no attacker here applies

Q.name: Infected Bonesaw
Q.note: not cast: a hit on a champion refunds the whole health cost, so the net is nothing (a Spirit Visage would make it +25% of the cost, about 6 health a second), and its damage is not scored

W.name: Heart Zapper
W.note: cast at the start and on cooldown (the cooldown starts at the cast). Grey health counts health lost after shields, Death's Dance's delayed damage included; the heal is a heal, so Spirit Visage amplifies it. The charge's damage ticks are not scored

E.name: Blunt Force Trauma

passive.note: bonus AD from his maximum health: only Maw of Malmortius's shield (200 + 150% bonus AD) reads it

E.note: not cast: it only costs health in a fight scored on survival

R.name: Maximum Dosage
R.note: once a fight (120 s cooldown). The base health lands at the cast, as maximum AND current health (it is not a heal: Spirit Visage does not touch it); the heal runs 10 s at a rate that follows his maximum health and is amplified by Spirit Visage. A Guardian Angel revive ends it (the wiki)
